issues.description: The solution's Farm class uses a Set<Animal> (HashSet) for the animals attribute and exposes/getters setters using Set, while the problem statement explicitly requires the aggregation to be realized using a List and implemented with an ArrayList (initialized in the no-arg constructor). This structural type mismatch between the specification and the provided solution can confuse students about the intended collection type and semantics (ordering, duplicates) and may cause tests or expected behavior that rely on a List/ArrayList to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Farm implementation consistent with the problem statement: change the animals attribute type to List<Animal>, initialize it as a new ArrayList<>() in the no-argument constructor, and update get/set/add methods to use List<Animal>. Alternatively, if Set semantics are intended, update the problem statement and UML to specify Set/HashSet instead so specification and implementation match.
